description_en: Initializes user alert resources, including an alert center Project (named in the format sls-alert-{uid}-{region}), a Logstore (named internal-alert-center-log), and related diagnostic dashboards
description_zh: 初始化用户告警资源，包含一个告警中心Project（名称格式为sls-alert-{uid}-{region}）、一个Logstore（名称为internal-alert-center-log）和相关诊断仪表盘
name: InitUserAlertResource

parameters.help_en: The dashboard language. cn indicates Chinese. en indicates English
parameters.help_zh: 仪表盘语言，cn代表中文，en代表英文
parameters.name: language

parameters.help_en: The region where the alert center Project resides, such as cn-shanghai
parameters.help_zh: 指定告警中心Project所在地域，格式如：cn-shanghai
parameters.name: region

Code.description_en: The error code. The value 200 indicates success

Message.description_en: The returned message. The value successful is returned upon success. An error message is returned upon failure
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful.

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true表示成功。
false表示失败
